title: Zephyr: Time Exceeded
close_reason: Implemented RFC 4443 Time Exceeded generation for hop-limit and fragment-reassembly codes with validated invoking IPv6 packet/source binding, extension-header inspection, error/Redirect/multicast/link-broadcast/non-unique-source/congestion suppression, zero unused field, canonical checksum/wire output, 1280-byte quote cap, and no-partial invalid/short-buffer behavior. Added shared-vector, first-fragment, suppression, malformed, boundary, standalone C, and Zephyr qemu tests. Green: qemu_x86 32/32, strict standalone C, clang-tidy, cppcheck, Python parity 6/6, Rust vector consumer 2/2, Rust no_std.
